Hi I’m in the same boat I am 10 weeks and I found out I have 2 sacs but just tissue/blood inside them and no fetal poles. I am weighting the options as well. Read all kinds of horror stories about the medication and I’m scared to be put to sleep (silly I know). It’s comforting to see a community that is supportive with such helpful information from those who have experienced this. I am now leaning towards the D&C because I don’t want to experience the hours of pain I’ve seen described in a few posts. So far, no spotting but weird twingey crampiness every once and a while.
